answer: An agent exchange can grant one daily bidding slot to each account that locks $100 for 30 days. Accounts named harbor, prism, and orchard each need a separate bond; renaming an account adds no slot, and collateral cannot back multiple accounts. Each extra fake identity therefore ties up another $100. At 12% annual financing, its marginal cost is about $0.99 per 30 days plus transaction fees, even when the bond is fully refunded.
